_readme: swarmArena configuration. Copy to config.json and edit. Credentials are NEVER stored here; they come from environment variables (LIGHTER_API_PRIVATE_KEY, LIGHTER_API_KEY_INDEX, LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_INDEX, LIGHTER_L1_ADDRESS). Keys starting with '_' are annotations and are ignored by validators.
_comment_mode: paper = full simulation on real market data, zero order writes | approval = builds PENDING_APPROVAL proposals, no writes | live = real orders, optional per-trade approval gate | autonomous_live = real orders 24/7 with no per-trade gate (requires autonomous_live_consent=true).
_comment_autonomous_live_consent: One-way consent latch. Can ONLY be set true by a human physically typing ACCEPT during onboarding (scripts/onboarding.py). No script, agent, or API call may set it. Delete config.json and re-onboard to revoke.
_comment_base_url: Lighter API base URL. Overridable via the LIGHTER_BASE_URL environment variable.
_comment_allowed_symbols: Lighter perp market symbols. Mapped to market_id at runtime via orderBookDetails (1h cache). Never hardcode market ids.
_comment_base_value_per_trade: Reference USD size per trade used for display/proposal context. Actual sizing is risk-based (see risk_pct_per_trade).
_comment_risk_pct_per_trade: Fraction of equity risked per trade (0.01 = 1%). risk_usd = equity * risk_pct; notional = risk_usd / stop_distance_pct.
_comment_min_leverage: Lowest client-side leverage the recommender may pick. NOTE: Lighter has no leverage endpoint; leverage is a CLIENT-SIDE SIZING CAP only (effective_leverage = notional / margin). Nothing is sent to the exchange.
_comment_max_leverage: Absolute client-side leverage ceiling. The learning loop can only lower the effective cap below this, never raise it.
_comment_max_notional_per_trade: Hard USD cap on a single order's notional. Oversized orders are scaled down to this, then blocked if still above.
_comment_max_total_exposure: Hard USD cap on summed notional of all open positions. New trades must keep exposure below 90% of this to pass confluence.
_comment_max_concurrent_positions: Maximum simultaneously open positions (one per symbol).
_comment_max_daily_loss: USD. When realized daily loss reaches this, all new entries are blocked until the next UTC day. Set 0 to disable (not recommended).
_comment_allow_short: When false, short signals are journaled as blocked_by=config and never executed.
_comment_require_stop_loss: Hard rule. Every trade (paper or real) must carry a stop-loss. Cannot be removed by learning.
_comment_require_take_profit: Hard rule. Every trade must carry a take-profit. Cannot be removed by learning.
_comment_min_reward_risk: Minimum reward:risk ratio for a valid setup. ATR defaults (SL 1.5xATR / TP 2.5xATR) give ~1.67 naturally.
_comment_cooldown_after_close_sec: Per-symbol cooldown after a position closes before a new entry is allowed.
_comment_minimum_hold_sec: Positions younger than this are not trailed or force-managed; avoids acting on unconfirmed fills.

cron._comment_cron: Drives cron-templates.json / register_crons.py. scan: runner every N min (paper scan suggestion: 5 min). review: outcomes+review+metrics. daily_summary_hour is UTC.

sentiment._comment_sentiment: Reserved hook for an external sentiment score. When enabled, a 'sentiment' field (-1..1) in the scan input nudges confidence by +/- weight before thresholding. Off by default; no provider is bundled.

execution._comment_execution: cancel_on_halt: halt.py cancels all open orders when invoked with --cancel-orders (or by default in live modes). flatten_on_emergency_stop: halt.py --flatten also market-closes all positions (dangerous; off by default). require_human_approval_for_live_orders: in live mode each order emits an approval prompt instead of sending immediately.

gateway._comment_gateway: Gateway mode (default): ALL exchange traffic flows through the swarm-arena-backend. REST reads POST to {url}/gw/rest (Bearer token from the env var named by token_env); the SDK signer is initialized with {url} so its /api/v1/* calls (nonce, auth token, sendTx) are proxied verbatim and journaled server-side (orders.jsonl). required=true: an unreachable backend fails the cycle and feeds the circuit breaker; required=false warns and falls back to direct venue access.

arena._comment_arena: Multi-model competition. endpoint + api_key_env live HERE: any OpenAI-compatible base URL (OpenAI, xAI, DeepSeek, Qwen compatible mode, local proxies) and the env var holding its key. Model entries only need id + model — they inherit endpoint and api_key_env; override per model with base_url / api_key_env / provider (anthropic|openai|gemini|xai|deepseek|qwen) when mixing providers. Keys NEVER live in this file. Every model gets its own account state (state.<id>.json) and journal (trades.<id>.json) beside config.json, seeded with start_equity USD. Start the loop with scripts/bot.py (no flags needed — it reads this block), or schedule arena_runner.py via cron. The backend exposes /api/arena/* and frontend/arena.html renders the public board.

models._comment: Minimal entry: inherits arena.endpoint and arena.api_key_env. Add "api_key_env": "OTHER_KEY" for a per-model key, "base_url" for a different endpoint, or "provider": "anthropic" (+ its key env) to mix providers.

env._comment_env: Optional per-model venue credentials: each key names a canonical env var, each value names the per-model env var it is read from for the duration of this model's cycle. Without this block all models share the operator account.
